So, we have three options for our vacation 
this summer. We can go to a beach resort, to the PandaLand Amusement Park or we can go camping at the lake! What do you think? We need to make a decision today. I want to go to PandaLand! It's more exciting than a boring old beach or camping. Well, honey... PandaLand is more expensive than the other two. And it will be more crowded. nice camping trip at the lake will be much quieter. Camping? I want to go to the beach resort. The hotel will be nicer, and the pool will be so much cleaner than a smelly lake! Camping would be cheaper but the hotel beds would be more comfortable than sleeping bags! True but the resort will be hotter, busier, and less interesting. Who wants to sit in the sun by a pool all day. I do!! If you want a more interesting vacation, they have jet skis, scuba diving and ocean fishing trips. Now that you mention it, I've always wanted to go scuba diving. And fishing in the ocean sounds more exciting than in a lake! Ok, I'm convinced! I'm not! I want to go to PandaLand! It's closer than the other two. So we will get there faster! You know the resort has a water slide, right? It does? And a huge playground. Bigger and better than any playground you've ever seen! Really? I'm more interested than I was before. I jump on the hotel bed? We'll see honey. Maybe... if it's stronger than your bed that you broke last month. What do you think, kiddo? We can go to PandaLand next year. You promise? Ok, I'm in! The resort sounds more fun than camping, that's for sure. Great! We all agree. we have to decide how to get there. We can fly, take a bus or drive our car. I don't want to drive. Gas prices are worse than ever, and it's more tiring than planes or buses. It's my vacation too! Ok, ok. So should we fly or take a bus? Ugh, I don't want to take a bus. It will be a longer trip. Yeah, and planes are way cooler! Let me take a look... It will be much harder to find good tickets if we decide to fly. Buses are way easier to book and there are lots of available seats on the dates we want. Buses are cheaper as well and the resort is already more expensive than the camping trip. I agree. Kids, buses are slower slower but the scenery will be more beautiful. And I can stretch my legs! Daddy's getting older! Ha ha, very funny. You know... On the bus we will see cool animals beside the highway. Will Yes, and we will stop for ice cream! Ice cream! Ok, the bus sounds way better than flying! Traitor.
